items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: I guess a lot of like Connors and Bob's daughters, brothers and people, all them kind of people out there on State Street

ctx.x: Because all them people recognized me, knew me, and Peter Williams, he used to be a drum player, he was the footman back there. He, you know, tuxed in. What happened to him? I mean he looked back, he looked back to Gravity Street somewhere back there by the old jail. Well he was the footman or he was the butler back there, something like that. And I played back. You see, all them big shots and top of the, I guess a lot of like Connors and Bob's daughters, brothers and people, all them kind of people out there on…
But they don't drink do they?
